scope: v2: recommendation consistency + tone + sample-vs-total + hedged-vs-asserted

findings.context: We audited 6 pages across stackoptic.com’s site using the Web Audit Suite.
findings.message: The "About This Report" section mixes first‑person narration (“We audited…”) with third‑person description (“The gap between those two results…”).

findings.context: We present the Human Experience subtable, which shows that across the audited set your pages deliver an excellent overall experience.
findings.message: The "Balanced Scorecard" section starts in first‑person (“We present the Human Experience subtable”) and then switches to third‑person (“Human Experience subtable shows…”).

findings.context: We identified 7 finding(s) on the audited set, ordered by regulatory exposure first and then by priority within each category.
findings.message: The "Findings" section begins with first‑person (“We identified 7 finding(s) on the audited set”) and then shifts to third‑person when detailing each priority.
